resources.string: Rank the largest files in a folder you authorize. Sizes and dates come from Android; nothing is deleted, renamed or hidden.
No folder chosen. Large Files needs read access to a folder you pick.
Part of this folder could not be read. The result stays partial and is labelled as such.
Read-only access is enough. Large Files never modifies or deletes.
Files below 1 MB are counted but not ranked. A file whose provider reports no size is never ranked with a guessed value.
%1$d files had no reported size and were excluded from the ranking.
The scan was cancelled. Only files found before cancellation are shown.
Ranked by provider-reported byte size, largest first.
Each tile is one file. Wider tiles are larger by measured bytes. Tap a tile to inspect it.
Tap a row or tile to inspect a file. Selection never deletes anything.
Showing the first %1$d results. Narrow the filters to inspect smaller subsets.
No app on this device can open this file type. The file was not modified.
KX reads only the folder you grant through Android\'s system picker. Paths, sizes and dates stay on this device. KX does not upload file contents, and Large Files has no delete action.
No file at or above 1 MB was found in this folder.
